mapper.select: SELECT TRD_SN FROM TRADE WHERE PRD_SN = #{productId} AND TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' ORDER BY TRD_SN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.BID_SN AS bidSn, t.TRD_SN AS tradeId FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{buyerUserId} AND t.BID_SN IN
#{bidSn}

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, t.BID_SN AS bidSn, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUsrSn, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCd, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount FROM TRADE t WHERE t.PRD_SN = #{productId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001'
ORDER BY t.TRD_REG_DT DESC, t.TRD_SN DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, t.TRD_TYPE_CD AS tradeTypeCode, t.BID_SN AS bidSn FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId}

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserId, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, t.REQ_USR_SN AS requesterUserId, t.PRV_USR_SN AS providerUserId, t.TRD_TYPE_CD AS tradeTypeCode, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE_DISPUTE ( TRD_SN, DSPT_USR_SN, TRD_DSP_TYPE_CD, TRD_DSP_STATUS_CD, TRD_DSP_CN, TRD_DSP_PREV_TRD_STATUS_CD, TRD_DSP_REG_ID, TRD_DSP_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{tradeId}, #{disputerUserId}, #{disputeTypeCode}, 'TRDC0016', #{content}, #{previousTradeStatusCode}, #{updaterId}, #{updaterId} )
INSERT INTO TRADE_DISPUTE_FILE ( TRD_DSP_SN, FL_SN, TRD_DSP_FL_SORT_NO, TRD_DSP_FL_REG_ID, TRD_DSP_FL_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{disputeSn}, #{fileSn}, #{sortOrder}, #{registrantId}, #{registrantId} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRD_SN AS tradeId, SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserId, BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode FROM TRADE WHERE (SLLR_USR_SN = #{userSn} OR BYPR_USR_SN = #{userSn}) AND TRD_STATUS_CD IN ('TRDC0003', 'TRDC0004', 'TRDC0005') ORDER BY TRD_SN ASC FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.REQ_USR_SN AS requesterUserId, t.PRV_USR_SN AS providerUserId, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus, t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT AS autoCompleteAt FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADE SET TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0005', TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT = #{autoCompleteAt}, TRD_UPDT_ID = #{updaterId} WHERE TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0003'
mapper.select: SELECT t.TRD_SN FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0005' AND t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT IS NOT NULL AND t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT <= #{now} ORDER BY t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT ASC, t.TRD_SN ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE ( SLLR_USR_SN, BYPR_USR_SN, PRD_SN, BID_SN, TRD_TYPE_CD, TRD_STATUS_CD, TRD_METHOD_CD, TRD_AMT ) VALUES ( #{sellerUserId}, #{buyerUserId}, #{productId}, #{bidId}, #{tradeTypeCode}, #{tradeStatusCode}, #{tradeMethodCode}, #{tradeAmount} )
mapper.select: SELECT TRD_SN FROM TRADE WHERE QUT_SN = #{quoteId} AND TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' ORDER BY TRD_SN DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE ( REQ_USR_SN, PRV_USR_SN, SVC_REQ_SN, QUT_SN, TRD_TYPE_CD, TRD_STATUS_CD, TRD_AMT ) VALUES ( #{requesterUserId}, #{providerUserId}, #{serviceRequestId}, #{quoteId}, #{tradeTypeCode}, #{tradeStatusCode}, #{tradeAmount} )

INSERT INTO TRADE_DELIVERY ( TRD_SN, TRD_DLVR_RCPNT_NM_ENC, TRD_DLVR_RCPNT_TELNO_ENC, TRD_DLVR_ADDR_ENC, TRD_DLVR_DADDR_ENC, TRD_DLVR_ZIP_ENC ) VALUES ( #{tradeId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{zip} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.PRD_SN AS prdSn, t.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCd, t.TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethodCd FROM TRADE t WHERE t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{sellerUserId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' ORDER BY t.TRD_REG_DT DESC, t.TRD_SN DESC

SELECT t.PRD_SN AS prdSn, t.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCd, t.TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethodCd, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount, t.TRD_REG_DT AS createdAt, completedHist.completedAt AS completedAt FROM TRADE t
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRD_SN, MAX(TRD_STS_HST_REG_DT) AS completedAt FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST WHERE TRD_STS_HST_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' GROUP BY TRD_SN ) completedHist ON completedHist.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN WHERE t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.PRD_SN IN
#{prdSn}
ORDER BY t.PRD_SN, t.TRD_REG_DT DESC, t.TRD_SN DESC

SELECT p.PRD_SN AS productId, t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN 'BUYER' ELSE 'SELLER' END AS viewerRole, CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN 'BUYER' ELSE 'SELLER' END AS userRole, p.PRD_NM AS productName, c.CAT_NM AS category, productImage.productImageUrl AS productImageUrl, CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN t.SLLR_USR_SN ELSE t.BYPR_USR_SN END AS counterpartUserId, CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN seller.USR_NM ELSE buyer.USR_NM END AS counterpartNickname, CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN sellerProfileFile.FL_PATH ELSE buyerProfileFile.FL_PATH END AS counterpartProfileImageUrl, CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN seller.USR_REG_DT ELSE buyer.USR_REG_DT END AS counterpartJoinedAt, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TRADE ct WHERE ct.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' AND ( ct.SLLR_USR_SN = CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN t.SLLR_USR_SN ELSE t.BYPR_USR_SN END OR ct.BYPR_USR_SN = CASE WHEN t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} THEN t.SLLR_USR_SN ELSE t.BYPR_USR_SN END ) ) AS counterpartCompletedTradeCount, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus, CASE WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0005' AND t.TRD_UPDT_ID = CAST(t.BYPR_USR_SN AS CHAR) THEN 'BUYER' WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0005' AND t.TRD_UPDT_ID = CAST(t.SLLR_USR_SN AS CHAR) THEN 'SELLER' ELSE NULL END AS completionRequestedBy, CASE t.TRD_METHOD_CD WHEN 'TRDC0009' THEN 'DELIVERY' WHEN 'TRDC0010' THEN 'OFFLINE' END AS tradeMethod, CASE WHEN chatRoom.CH_RM_SN IS NULL THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD IN ('TRDC0006', 'TRDC0007', 'TRDC0008') THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN chatRoom.CH_RM_STATUS_CD = 'CHRC0001' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'CLOSED' END AS chatRoomStatus, t.TRD_REG_DT AS createdAt, completedHist.completedAt AS completedAt, t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT AS autoCompleteAt, d.TRD_DLVR_RCPNT_NM_ENC AS recipientName, d.TRD_DLVR_RCPNT_TELNO_ENC AS recipientPhone, d.TRD_DLVR_ADDR_ENC AS deliveryAddress, d.TRD_DLVR_DADDR_ENC AS deliveryDetailAddress, d.TRD_DLVR_MEMO_CN AS deliveryMessage, d.TRD_DLVR_SN AS deliveryId, d.TRD_DLVR_UPDT_DT AS deliveryProofRegisteredAt, o.TRD_OFL_DT AS meetingDateTime, o.TRD_OFL_PLC_NM AS meetingPlace, o.TRD_OFL_ADDR_ENC AS meetingAddress FROM TRADE t JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = t.PRD_SN JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.CAT_SN = p.CAT_SN JOIN USERS seller ON seller.USR_SN = t.SLLR_USR_SN JOIN USERS buyer ON buyer.USR_SN = t.BYPR_USR_SN LEFT JOIN FILES sellerProfileFile ON sellerProfileFile.FL_SN = seller.USR_PRFL_FL_SN AND sellerProfileFile.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN FILES buyerProfileFile ON buyerProfileFile.FL_SN = buyer.USR_PRFL_FL_SN AND buyerProfileFile.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pi.PRD_SN, f.FL_PATH AS productImageUrl FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE pi JOIN FILES f ON f.FL_SN = pi.FL_SN AND f.FL_USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN ( SELECT PRD_SN, MIN(CASE WHEN PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END * 100000 + PRD_IMG_SORT_NO) AS sortKey FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE GROUP BY PRD_SN ) picked ON picked.PRD_SN = pi.PRD_SN AND picked.sortKey = CASE WHEN pi.PRD_IMG_RPRS_YN = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END * 100000 + pi.PRD_IMG_SORT_NO ) productImage ON productImage.PRD_SN = p.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN TRADE_DELIVERY d ON d.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN LEFT JOIN TRADE_OFFLINE o ON o.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN LEFT JOIN CHAT_ROOM chatRoom ON chatRoom.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TRD_SN, MAX(TRD_STS_HST_REG_DT) AS completedAt FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST WHERE TRD_STS_HST_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0006' GROUP BY TRD_SN ) completedHist ON completedHist.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND (t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{userId} OR t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId})
SELECT t.TRD_SN FROM TRADE t WHERE t.PRD_SN = #{productId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND (t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{userId} OR t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId}) ORDER BY t.TRD_SN DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.REQ_USR_SN AS requesterUserId, t.PRV_USR_SN AS providerUserId, t.SVC_REQ_SN AS serviceRequestId, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount, t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT AS autoCompleteAt, sr.SVC_REQ_TTL AS serviceRequestTitle, q.QUT_CN AS quoteSummary, requestedSchedule.scheduleLabel, CASE WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD IS NOT NULL THEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0003' THEN 'ESCROW_HELD' ELSE NULL END AS escrowStatusCode, CASE WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0001' THEN '정산 대기 중입니다.' WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0002' THEN '분쟁 처리로 정산이 보류되었습니다.' WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0003' THEN '정산이 완료되었습니다.' WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0003' THEN '보관금이 안전하게 보관 중입니다.' ELSE NULL END AS escrowStatusLabel, CASE WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0003' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHAT_ROOM cr WHERE cr.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN AND cr.CH_RM_STATUS_CD = 'CHRC0001' ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS chatAvailable, CASE WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0003' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST cancelRequest WHERE cancelRequest.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN AND cancelRequest.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_REQUEST|%' AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(cancelRequest.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN, '|', 2), '|', -1 ) AS UNSIGNED) <> #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST cancelDecision WHERE cancelDecision.TRD_SN = cancelRequest.TRD_SN AND cancelDecision.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE CONCAT( 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_DECISION|', cancelRequest.TRD_STS_HST_SN, '|%') ) ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS cancellationDecisionAvailable FROM TRADE t JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST sr ON sr.SVC_REQ_SN = t.SVC_REQ_SN JOIN QUOTE q ON q.QUT_SN = t.QUT_SN LEFT JOIN ( /* 요청서의 카테고리별 날짜 필드 중 가장 이른 선택일을 기본 서비스 일정으로 표시한다. */ SELECT i.SVC_REQ_SN, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y. %m. %d.') AS scheduleLabel FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' GROUP BY i.SVC_REQ_SN ) requestedSchedule ON requestedSchedule.SVC_REQ_SN = t.SVC_REQ_SN LEFT JOIN SETTLEMENT st ON st.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND (t.REQ_USR_SN = #{userId} OR t.PRV_USR_SN = #{userId})

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.REQ_USR_SN AS requesterUserId, t.PRV_USR_SN AS providerUserId, t.SVC_REQ_SN AS serviceRequestId, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount, t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT AS autoCompleteAt, sr.SVC_REQ_TTL AS serviceRequestTitle, q.QUT_CN AS quoteSummary, requestedSchedule.scheduleLabel, CASE WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD IS NOT NULL THEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0003' THEN 'ESCROW_HELD' ELSE NULL END AS escrowStatusCode, CASE WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0001' THEN '정산 대기 중입니다.' WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0002' THEN '분쟁 처리로 정산이 보류되었습니다.' WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0003' THEN '정산이 완료되었습니다.' WHEN st.STLM_STATUS_CD = 'STLC0004' THEN '전액 환불로 정산이 종결되었습니다.' WHEN t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0003' THEN '보관금이 안전하게 보관 중입니다.' ELSE NULL END AS escrowStatusLabel, FALSE AS chatAvailable, FALSE AS cancellationDecisionAvailable FROM TRADE t JOIN SERVICE_REQUEST sr ON sr.SVC_REQ_SN = t.SVC_REQ_SN JOIN QUOTE q ON q.QUT_SN = t.QUT_SN LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.SVC_REQ_SN, DATE_FORMAT(MIN(STR_TO_DATE(i.SVC_REQ_ITM_VAL_CN, '%Y-%m-%d')), '%Y. %m. %d.') AS scheduleLabel FROM SVC_REQ_ITEM i JOIN SVC_REQ_FIELD_DEF f ON f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN = i.SVC_REQ_FIELD_SN WHERE f.SVC_REQ_FIELD_TYPE_CD = 'CALENDAR' GROUP BY i.SVC_REQ_SN ) requestedSchedule ON requestedSchedule.SVC_REQ_SN = t.SVC_REQ_SN LEFT JOIN SETTLEMENT st ON st.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002'

SELECT a.SVC_REQ_ADDR_ENC AS encryptedAddress, a.SVC_REQ_DADDR_ENC AS encryptedDetailAddress, a.SVC_REQ_ZIP_ENC AS encryptedZonecode FROM TRADE t JOIN SVC_REQ_ADDRESS a ON a.SVC_REQ_SN = t.SVC_REQ_SN WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0002' AND a.SVC_REQ_ADDR_USE_YN = 'Y' AND (t.REQ_USR_SN = #{userId} OR t.PRV_USR_SN = #{userId}) ORDER BY a.SVC_REQ_STEP_SN, a.ADDR_ROLE_KEY, a.SVC_REQ_ADDR_SEQ_NO

SELECT h.TRD_STS_HST_SN AS id, CASE WHEN h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CHANGE|%' THEN 'CHANGE' WHEN h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_REQUEST|%' THEN 'CANCEL_REQUEST' WHEN h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE '%|APPROVED' THEN 'CANCEL_APPROVED' WHEN h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE '%|REJECTED' THEN 'CANCEL_REJECTED' ELSE 'CANCEL' END AS eventType, h.TRD_STS_HST_REG_DT AS occurredAt, CASE WHEN h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CHANGE|%' THEN STR_TO_DATE( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN, '|', 2), '|', -1), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') ELSE NULL END AS requestedScheduleAt, CASE WHEN h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_DECISION%|APPROVED' THEN '상대방이 일정 취소 요청에 동의했습니다. 거래가 취소되고 보관금이 환불되었습니다.' WHEN h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_DECISION%|REJECTED' THEN '상대방이 일정 취소 요청을 거절했습니다. 거래는 계속 진행됩니다.' ELSE SUBSTRING( h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN, LOCATE('|', h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN, LOCATE('|', h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN) + 1) + 1) END AS reason FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST h WHERE h.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND ( h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CHANGE|%' OR h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL|%' OR h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_REQUEST|%' OR h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_DECISION|%' ) ORDER BY h.TRD_STS_HST_REG_DT DESC, h.TRD_STS_HST_SN DESC

SELECT h.TRD_STS_HST_SN AS historyId, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN, '|', 2), '|', -1 ) AS UNSIGNED) AS requesterUserId FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST h WHERE h.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND h.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_REQUEST|%' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE_STATUS_HIST decision WHERE decision.TRD_SN = h.TRD_SN AND decision.TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN LIKE CONCAT( 'SCHEDULE_CANCEL_DECISION|', h.TRD_STS_HST_SN, '|%') ) ORDER BY h.TRD_STS_HST_SN DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT f.FL_SN AS fileId, f.TRD_DLVR_FL_SORT_NO AS sortOrder FROM TRADE_DELIVERY_FILE f WHERE f.TRD_DLVR_SN = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY f.TRD_DLVR_FL_SORT_NO ASC, f.FL_SN ASC

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, d.TRD_DLVR_SN AS deliveryId, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus FROM TRADE t JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = t.PRD_SN LEFT JOIN TRADE_DELIVERY d ON d.TRD_SN = t.TRD_SN WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{sellerUserId} AND t.TRD_METHOD_CD = 'TRDC0009' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE_DELIVERY (TRD_SN) VALUES (#{tradeId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TRD_SN = VALUES(TRD_SN)
mapper.select: SELECT TRD_DLVR_SN FROM TRADE_DELIVERY WHERE TRD_SN = #{tradeId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.TRD_SN FROM TRADE t JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = t.PRD_SN WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{sellerUserId} AND t.TRD_METHOD_CD = 'TRDC0010' FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE_OFFLINE ( TRD_SN, TRD_OFL_PLC_NM, TRD_OFL_ADDR_ENC, TRD_OFL_DT ) VALUES ( #{tradeId}, #{meetingPlace}, #{meetingAddress}, #{meetingDateTime} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TRD_OFL_PLC_NM = VALUES(TRD_OFL_PLC_NM), TRD_OFL_ADDR_ENC = VALUES(TRD_OFL_ADDR_ENC), TRD_OFL_DT = VALUES(TRD_OFL_DT)
mapper.select: SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserId, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus, t.TRD_METHOD_CD AS tradeMethod, t.TRD_UPDT_ID AS completionRequesterId, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount FROM TRADE t JOIN PRODUCT p ON p.PRD_SN = t.PRD_SN WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND (t.BYPR_USR_SN = #{userId} OR t.SLLR_USR_SN = #{userId}) FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TRADE_OFFLINE WHERE TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND TRD_OFL_DT IS NOT NULL AND TRD_OFL_PLC_NM IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(TRD_OFL_PLC_NM) <> '' )

SELECT t.TRD_SN FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0005' AND t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT IS NOT NULL AND t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT <= #{now} ORDER BY t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT ASC, t.TRD_SN ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserId, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, t.TRD_AMT AS tradeAmount, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus, t.TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT AS autoCompleteAt FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' AND t.TRD_STATUS_CD = 'TRDC0005' FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.TRD_SN AS tradeId, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserId, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserId, t.BID_SN AS bidSn, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatus FROM TRADE t WHERE t.TRD_SN = #{tradeId} AND t.TRD_TYPE_CD = 'TRDC0001' FOR UPDATE
